subject: Post-call: monthly commit band, $/1M token target, and procurement trigger
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@bridgehead.ai>
Cc: Tom O'Neill <tom.oneill@bridgehead.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: monthly commit band, $/1M token target, and procurement trigger

Thanks again for the call earlier — appreciated the deep dive on the analytics pipelines and where model inference will sit in your product flow. Quick recap and the asks I promised: 

Summary of what we discussed
- Primary usage: interactive insights + batch re-ranks for nightly scoring. Estimated avg request length ~1.2k tokens; peak session lengths up to ~6k tokens for some notebooks.
- Expected call volume: 40k-75k calls/day (current estimate; you and Tom will validate).
- Key constraint: procurement needs a clear monthly spend band to determine whether a PO is required versus card/charge.

Initial cost / economics framing (very rough)
- Conservative token estimate (monthly): 120M tokens -> Aggressive: 400M tokens.
- Unit target you mentioned: target $/1M tokens ~ $40–$55. Using $45/1M as a midpoint: 120M tokens => $5,400/month; 400M => $18,000/month.
- Potential optimizations: prefix caching and batching (your nightly batch is a good fit) could reduce effective tokens 15–30% depending on reuse.

Procurement thresholds we mapped to Redwood offers
- Band A (low): <$5k/month — self-serve, credit-card ok.
- Band B (mid): $5k–$25k/month — PO preferred; standard SOW, 30-day terms.
- Band C (enterprise): >$25k/month — PO + procurement review + optional dedicated capacity; legal and security checklist triggered at >$75k/month.

Requested next steps
1) Can you confirm the expected monthly token range (low / expected / high) by EOD Thu (so I can presize the contract tier)?
2) Please confirm whether procurement wants a single PO for platform + infra or separate line items (they asked on the call).
3) I'll attach a light pricing workbook and a draft SOW for your procurement/finance to review.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_v1.xlsx (pricing workbook, workbook contains three band scenarios), SOW-draft.pdf (one-page SOW, draft)

If it helps I can also provide a short one-pager that maps your monthly token volumes to procurement language ("Estimated monthly spend: $X–$Y; PO threshold will be Z") for your internal review.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0116

---
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@bridgehead.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom O'Neill <tom.oneill@bridgehead.ai>, procurement@bridgehead.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: monthly commit band, $/1M token target, and procurement trigger

Connor — thanks for the write-up, that aligns well. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Token range: low ~100M, expected ~210M, high ~480M (the night re-ranks are the big variable).
2) Target unit: we were hoping to land closer to $38–$45/1M after accounting for caching. The $45 midpoint you showed is reasonable for initial sizing.
3) Procurement: for amounts <= $20k/month they will accept a standard PO. Above that threshold they want to engage procurement/finance for a consolidated PO that covers platform + cloud egress (we will need a line-item breakdown).

Action for us: Tom and I will confirm the daily call volumes and expected batching/reuse patterns by Thu COB. Procurement is looped (procurement@bridgehead.ai) and will review SOW once you send it.

Also: could you confirm whether any onboarding credits or trial committed credits exist for a 3-month ramp? That helps define initial banding.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Head of Data Products | Bridgehead Analytics
rachel.kim@bridgehead.ai

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 18:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: monthly commit band, $/1M token target, and procurement trigger

Marissa — forwarding the above thread. Bridgehead confirmed a likely range (100M / 210M / 480M). Procurement note: they treat <= $20k/month as standard PO; > $20k requires consolidated PO + line items and finance sign-off.

Questions for pricing/finance:
- Can we give a committed 3-month ramp credit (e.g., 20% off month 1–3) for a mid-band commitment (210M expected)?
- If they land at ~210M tokens and we price at $42/1M tokens (negotiated), monthly is ~$8,820. That stays in Band B (PO preferred) but < $25k — procurement mentioned $20k threshold specifically. Does legal or revenue ops have a preferred PO template for this band?

Attaching the workbook we shared to the customer and a draft SOW. If you can advise on standard commercial concessions for first-year ramp that would be helpful — call out limits (max credit, one-off, not stackable with other promos).

Thanks,
Connor

Attachment: redwood_pricing_v1.xlsx

Subject: RE: Post-call: monthly commit band, $/1M token target, and procurement trigger — proposed next steps

Rachel — quick update after internal sync with pricing and legal: 

Confirmed commercial options for initial term
- Ramp credit: 20% off list unit price for first 3 months for customers committing to a 3-month median band (we'd need an expectation email confirming the "expected" monthly tokens).
- Example math (for transparency): expected 210M tokens x $42/1M = $8,820/month pre-credit. With 20% ramp month 1–3 -> $7,056/month effective for months 1–3.
- PO thresholds: Redwood standard PO accepted for up to $25k/month. Above $25k/month we require procurement/finance review and a short SOW amendment; >$75k/month triggers data-security review (dedicated/private options).

What I'm proposing as next steps
1) Tom/Rachel confirm the low/expected/high token numbers in an email reply (this will serve as the "expected" volume for the ramp credit).
2) Procurement: if you want a single consolidated PO, I'll ask our revenue ops team to prepare a line-item estimate (platform vs infra) to attach to the SOW. Marissa, can you own that if Bridgehead confirms band B vs C?
3) I'll attach a revised SOW that includes the 3-month ramp credit clause and the PO line-item template.

If that all sounds good I can set a 30-minute handoff call with procurement/finance next week — I'll coordinate on availability.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
